sources.title: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 Specs | TechPowerUp GPU Database
sources.snippet: The GeForce RTX 4090 was an enthusiast-class graphics card by NVIDIA, launched on October 12th, 2022. Built on the 5 nm process, and based on the AD102 graphics processor, in its AD102-300-A1 variant, the card supports DirectX 12 Ultimate. This ensures that all modern games will run on GeForce RTX 4090.

sources.title: NVIDIA RTX 4090 Specs, Price & AI Performance Guide (2026)
sources.snippet: The 4090 tdp is 450W, and real rtx 4090 power consumption under sustained load lands close to that ceiling. NVIDIA recommends at least an 850W PSU, though most builders pairing it with a high-end CPU aim for 1,000W or more to cover transient spikes.

sources.title: Understanding the Power Consumption of Modern High Bandwidth Memory: Experimental Analysis and Modeling Using Real HBM2 DRAM Chips
sources.snippet: We perform the first comprehensive experimental characterization of power consumed by real HBM2 DRAM chips. Our extensive characterization yields 1) the empirical basis for developing new, accurate HBM power models or validating existing power models and 2) key insights into structural and data-pattern-dependent variation of power in HBM2 chips.
